name: judgment
wording: once per cut, when the build is green: the held-out examples run, and independent assayers, as many as proportionality sets and on different model families where available (0146), each judge what cannot execute, whether the work keeps to the operator's requirements and the lead's recorded decisions, and whether the examples still express their concepts, any disagreement between two going to the architect as a meaning question; a finding about the work returns to the builders as a failing case and is confirmed by re-running that case or by an assayer re-judging that finding alone, and every other place the same defect occurs is swept in the same round, while a finding that an example no longer expresses its concept goes to the architect as a meaning question, so acceptance is independent and the whole cut is judged once; a check is adequate when it rejects the plausible failure modes its example names, and a contrived way around it is recorded as future work on the check, never as a finding against the work.
reason: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Judgment fixed two assayers against proportionality, and named negative recordings and hardening notes, which the record never defines.
